title: Stress: slippage 3 ticks + commission doubled
question: What do higher execution costs do to the locked strategy?
verdict: Costs re-priced on the exact replay (slippage 3 ticks, commission x2): 2026 +16,335 (PF 3.13), 2021-25 +6,897 (PF 1.11); cold-streak state flipped on 26 trades.
notes: pnl = (exit - entry) x dir x micros x $2 - commission x mult - extra slippage (ticks - 1) x $0.50 x micros x legs (entry leg + exit leg unless TARGET). R recomputed, so the cold-streak filter sees the stressed record.
method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
